page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 959 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that this server exhibits modest computational and memory throughput. In stress-ng testing, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25% tier, with scores of 1101.89 and 2923.84 respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block rate of 20.18 GB/sec, which is categorized in the bottom 10%. Database and web serving metrics also reflect lower-tier performance, with Redis SET operations registering at 2.97 million operations per second and static web serving throughput reaching 2.52 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.i2ne.xlarge offers a high ratio of memory and local SSD storage relative to its processing cores. This makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that require substantial local storage space and memory capacity but do not demand high-frequency CPU performance. The hardware configuration is appropriate for lightweight database hosting, caching layers, and memory-intensive background tasks that can operate within the constraints of its 2 Gbps network baseline and lower-tier processing speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.xlarge is an x86_64 server featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM and a bundled 959 GB local SSD. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Benchmark data indicates modest performance, with CPU and memory bandwidth metrics consistently placing in the lower percentiles, including a stress-ng multi-core score of 2923.84 and a large-block memory read speed of 20.18 GB/sec. Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core and substantial local SSD storage, this server is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-oriented and storage-reliant workloads that do not require high-frequency compute power. It is suitable for lightweight databases, caching systems, and general-purpose tasks with moderate network requirements.
